FIELDS.NAME: Sole Solutions Shoe Store & Repair
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sole Solutions Shoe Store & Repair, we specialize in providing high-quality footwear and expert repair services. Our operations encompass a retail environment where customers can find a diverse selection of shoes, including casual, athletic, and formal varieties, sourced from reputable suppliers. We pride ourselves on our attentive customer service and knowledgeable staff, who assist customers in selecting the perfect pair of shoes to meet their needs.

In addition to our retail offerings, we provide comprehensive shoe repair services, handled by skilled technicians with extensive training in various repair techniques. Our repair services include resoling, stitching, and customizing footwear, all while maintaining a commitment to using safe, non-hazardous materials. We ensure that our shop is well-maintained, compliant with local safety codes, and that our operations reflect excellent safety practices with minimal workplace incidents.

Our business hours are designed to accommodate our customers, and we actively engage in community events and promotions to enhance our local presence. Overall, our operations aim to deliver a satisfying shopping experience while upholding high standards of safety, quality, and customer service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a water pipe burst in the storage area of the store, causing damage to inventory and flooring. The total loss was $1,500. The claim has been processed and is currently closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sunday 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class I, Grade B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with video surveillance.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Our operations do not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We prioritize safety and only use non-hazardous materials for our shoe repair services.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – We do not currently sponsor any athletic teams as part of our marketing or community engagement initiatives.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by the management to ensure compliance with insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – We have not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All our insurance policies have remained active and compliant.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – We do not lease employees to or from other employers; all our staff are directly employed by Sole Solutions Shoe Store & Repair. We focus on maintaining a dedicated and well-trained team to serve our customers effectively.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – We do not currently carry Workers' Compensation insurance, as we operate with a small team and our employees are fully trained and prioritized safety measures to minimize workplace risks.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – We own and operate another business, Sole Solutions Fashion Boutique, in addition to our shoe store and repair services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – We do not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Our only existing policy is listed as SOL-2023-001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retailing shoes and providing repair services using safe, non-hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others as part of our business operations. Our focus is solely on retailing shoes and providing repair services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Our operations do not involve exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as we focus exclusively on using non-hazardous materials for our shoe repair services. We prioritize safety and compliance with all relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – We do not have any catastrophe exposure that could impact our operations or increase risk. Our business focuses on retail and repair services without high-risk elements associated with catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize safety and compliance with all regulations, ensuring a respectful and secure environment for employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations reported for Sole Solutions Shoe Store & Repair. The business maintains compliance with local safety codes and prioritizes a safe operating environment.
